title: What If Malaria Vanished Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if malaria vanished tomorrow? The first number is brutal.
In 2023, malaria infected about 263 million people across 83 countries.
It killed about 597,000 of them, and Africa had 94 percent of the cases and 95 percent of the deaths.
Gone overnight, that is nearly 600,000 fewer funerals every single year.
The World Health Organization says new tools already averted over a million deaths and 177 million cases in 2023 alone.
Eleven African countries carry about two thirds of the burden, so the biggest change would land there first.
It would be one of the largest drops in human suffering ever recorded, from a single mosquito borne parasite.

description:
What if malaria vanished tomorrow?
It infected about 263 million people and killed about 597,000 in 2023, almost all of them in Africa.
